title: 7 steps to start your business from ZERO in 2025
aboutGuest: Entrepreneur, content creator, and founder based in Silicon Valley. Marina interviews the world's top tech leaders, investors, and innovators to uncover the trends, strategies, and mindsets shaping the future. With millions of followers across platforms, she brings a unique perspective on technology, business, and personal growth.
summary: Marina Mogilko outlines 7 actionable steps for launching a business from scratch in 2025, emphasizing how AI-powered tools can accelerate growth and reduce startup barriers. She covers niche identification, brand building, online presence, customer service automation, and financial management, drawing on her own experience founding the healthy snacks company Daily Value (Yumkin). The episode highlights how AI tools now enable solo founders to operate at a level that previously required entire teams.
keyTakeaways: AI tools have raised the average growth benchmark at top accelerators like Y Combinator to 10% week-over-week — a rate that was once achieved by only 1–2% of startups.

Tools like Exploding Topics, Google Trends, Statista, SEMrush Market Explorer, and Helium 10 can help entrepreneurs identify emerging niches before they hit mainstream, giving businesses a built-in growth tailwind.
Setting up business banking from day one is critical — Marina recommends Relay for its free account structure, up to 20 sub-accounts for expense categories, and seamless QuickBooks/Xero integration.
Traditional 20-page business plans are largely obsolete in the startup world; modern investors prioritize founder ambition and traction over detailed financial spreadsheets.

Automating customer service and streamlining operations early — using AI tools for tasks like email marketing (Omnisend) and social scheduling (Hootsuite) — allows solo founders to scale without proportionally increasing headcount or costs.
